name: ds3-sprint-board
description: Review and update the DS3 sprint board (members.ds3atucsd.com/sprints) from Claude.
long_description: Read the club-wide sprint board and create, assign, move and review tasks as yourself. Sign in with your DS3 members-portal email and password; Claude then acts with your own account, so you can do exactly what you can on the website. Board and Executive members only.

author.name: Data Science Student Society at UC San Diego

email.title: DS3 members-portal email
email.description: The email you sign in to members.ds3atucsd.com with.

password.title: Members-portal password
password.description: Stored by Claude as a sensitive setting and only sent to DS3's Supabase sign-in.
